atoms.statement: Choose 'Fail loud + signal hygiene' as a primary direction.
atoms.test: Document lists 'Fail loud + signal hygiene' as a chosen direction, justified by repo data (restart-root-cause-log, audit.launches.jsonl).

atoms.statement: Choose 'Risk-proportional pipeline weight' or 'Depth-Aware Decomposition and Routing' as a direction to improve speed/routing.
atoms.test: Document lists a speed/routing improvement direction, justified by metrics data (planner_ms/verify_ms dominance, task step counts).

atoms.statement: Choose 'Protected self-maintenance completion contract' as a direction.
atoms.test: Document lists 'Protected self-maintenance completion contract' as a chosen direction, justified by audit.launches.jsonl data.

atoms.statement: Choose 'Error Contract Enforcement' as a primary direction.
atoms.test: Document lists 'Error Contract Enforcement' as a primary direction, justified by data on autonomous task interruptions.

atoms.statement: The durable plan document is the only artifact for this task; implementation is future work after operator review.
atoms.test: Deliverable is a decisions/ document, contains no code, lists atoms with details, reuse map, and no-new-layer statement.

atoms.statement: No new mechanisms or layers will be introduced; all hardening is achieved by configuring, connecting, or strengthening existing error contracts, audit ledger, restart attribution, depth-router, and gates.
atoms.test: All changes are confined to existing mechanism directories; no new files, processes, schemas, or watchers are introduced; all changes are additive, preserving compatibility with downstream parsers.

atoms.statement: Implementation atoms are granular: 1 file / 1 change, each gated by ParseFile + smoke + a targeted test assertion, with commit per atom.
atoms.test: Each implementation atom is a single file change, passes ParseFile, smoke, and one new assertion in an existing test file.

atoms.statement: For fail-loud, reuse existing error contracts, audit ledger, delivery-gate facts, and restart attribution rather than adding a new alert layer.
atoms.test: No new alert layer, persistent store, or gate family is introduced for fail-loud; changes are additive to existing mechanisms.

atoms.statement: Treat protected self-maintenance completion as a subcase of fail-loud, not as a separate direction.
atoms.test: Document states self-maintenance is subcase of fail-loud, not a separate direction.

atoms.statement: Implement self-maintenance completion contract as a new decision value ('window_incomplete') written through the existing Write-AuditLaunchLedgerEntry and detected by the existing stale-start reconcile.
atoms.test: Extend tools/test-audit-launch-guard.ps1 — started-without-terminal window -> exactly one window_incomplete entry with reason.

atoms.statement: Surface the self-maintenance completion-contract result through the existing auditor stale-alert (gates), classifying benign reasons as non-alerting terminal reasons.
atoms.test: Extend tools/test-auditor-stale-alert.ps1 — incomplete window raises exactly one alert, complete window raises none.

atoms.statement: Embed mandatory error contract checks into the autonomous loop's commit boundary, reusing the ledger as the enforcement ledger.
atoms.test: Ledger acts as enforcement ledger; every state transition at commit boundary passes contract check or logs violation.

atoms.statement: Reuse restart-attribution to provide the 'why' for error contract violations, linking violation log entry to attribution record.
atoms.test: Error contract violation log entries are linked to restart-attribution records.

atoms.statement: Tune/integrate the existing depth-router and mode selection into the task ingestion gate for speed and depth-aware decomposition, instead of adding another classifier.
atoms.test: Metrics show reduced planner_ms/verify_ms on Standard plan-only tasks, with no increase in failures; task ingestion gate includes depth-assessment step from depth-router.

atoms.statement: Implement finding dedup by reusing the existing Get-BacklogDuplicateFindingType detector at the finding-append site, collapsing identical findings within a window into one entry with count/first_seen/last_seen.
atoms.category: Data Handling / Signal Hygiene / Mechanism Reuse
atoms.test: Own test feeds 5 identical runtime-incident-model findings and asserts 1 collapsed entry with count=5.
